| | |

| URI | `https://openmusickit.org/spec/wsmn` |
| version | `0.1` |
| prefix | `wsmn` |

Western Standard Music Notation:
the pitch, duration, chord, key, clef, bar line and percussion types of
common Western notation.
WSMN is one musical system among others, not a default;
a document uses this vocabulary only when it holds WSMN values.
Names are written with the prefix: `wsmn:TonalVector`.
Section numbers (§4.3) refer to [the format specification](omk-json.qmd),
and kinds (in *italics*) to the [`omk` vocabulary](vocabulary-omk.qmd#kinds).

## Systems

| identifier | system | type |
|---|---|---|
| `wsmn:tonal` | WSMN pitch: seven letter names and twelve semitones to the octave | tonal |
| `wsmn:percussion` | WSMN unpitched percussion | tonal |
| `wsmn:metrical` | WSMN metrical time: note values, dots and tuplets | temporal |

## Pitch

**`TonalVector`**: a pitch, a pitch class, or an interval, spelled.
Kinds *Tone* and *Interval*. System `wsmn:tonal`.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `diatonic` | `integer` | 0–6: the letter name, counted in steps from C (0 = C, 1 = D, ... 6 = B); as an interval, the number of letter steps |
| `chromatic` | `integer` | 0–11: the pitch class, counted in semitones from C; as an interval, the number of semitones, modulo 12 |
| `octave` | `integer?` | the octave of the *letter name*, 0 for the octave beginning at middle C; `null` for a pitch class or a simple interval |

The two coordinates spell the pitch:
`(0, 0)` is C, `(0, 1)` is C♯, `(1, 1)` is D♭, `(0, 11)` is C♭.
The octave counts by letter, not by sound:
`(0, 11, 0)` is C♭4 and `(6, 0, 0)` is B♯4,
although C♭4 sounds a semitone below C4 and B♯4 sounds as C5.
A value with `octave` `null` and one with an `octave` are different values,
even where the octave is 0.

Display forms, for name templates
(see the [`omk` vocabulary](vocabulary-omk.qmd#name-templates)):
`unicode` (the default; `E♭4`), `ascii` (`Eb4`), `letter` (`E`),
`verbose` (`Eflat4`), `ly` and `ly_absolute` (LilyPond, `ees`).

## Durations

**`MetricalDuration`**: a note value, with its dots and the tuplet it is in.
Kinds *Duration* and *Measurable*. System `wsmn:metrical`.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `numerator` | `integer` | non-zero; its absolute value is a power of two (1, 2, 4, ...); negative for a negative (signed) duration |
| `denominator` | `integer` | a positive power of two; if the numerator's absolute value is more than 1, the denominator is 1 |
| `dots` | `integer` | not negative |
| `ratio` | *TemporalRatio*? | the tuplet: the notated values against the values they stand in for; `null` outside a tuplet |

The fields are the *nominal* note value, in lowest terms, plus the dots:
a dotted quarter is `1/4` with one dot (its length, 3/8, is not written);
a half is `1/2`, never `2/4`;
a breve is `2/1`, a longa `4/1`.
A quarter in a quarter-note triplet is `1/4` with the `ratio`
3 quarters (`nominal`) against 2 quarters (`contextual`).
A value in any other form is outside the domain and a reader rejects it:
`2/4` (write `1/2`), `3/8` (write `1/4` with one dot), `6/1` (write `4/1` with one dot).

A note value's length is
`numerator/denominator × (2 − 1/2^dots)`,
multiplied, when there is a ratio,
by the ratio's contextual length over its nominal length.

**`TiedDuration`**: two or more durations tied into one, in order.
Kinds *Duration* and *Measurable*. System `wsmn:metrical`.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `members` | `array<`*Duration*`>` | at least two |

**`TimeSignature`**: a meter, as the units it groups and as it is printed.
Kind *Measurable*.

| field | type | |
|---|---|---|
| `units` | `array<`*Measurable*`>` | the beats or groups: 4/4 is four quarters, 2+2+3/8 three groups of eighths |
| `presentation` | `array<string>?` | exactly two strings, as printed (`["4", "4"]`, `["2+2+3", "8"]`); `null` if not given |

4/4 and 2/2 have the same length and are different values:
a time signature is written in full and compared field by field.

## Chords

**`ChordType`**: a chord quality, independent of root: a major triad, a dominant seventh.
Kind *ToneCollection*.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `tones` | `array<TonalVector>` | the chord's tones as intervals above the root; includes `(0, 0)` (octave `null`) |
| `root` | `TonalVector` | always `(0, 0)` with octave `null`: the tones are measured from it |
| `name` | `string` | a name template |
| `bass` | `TonalVector` | the interval above the root of the lowest tone: `(0, 0)` in root position |
| `quality` | chord quality? | |
| `suffix` | `string?` | the lead-sheet suffix (`"maj7"`, `"sus4"`; `""` for a plain major triad) |

**`Chord`**: a chord on a particular root: C major, G7/B.
Kind *ToneCollection*.

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `root` | `TonalVector` |
| `tones` | `array<TonalVector>` |
| `bass` | `TonalVector` |
| `name` | `string?` (a name template) |
| `suffix` | `string?` |

## Keys

**`KeySignature`**: the alteration of each letter name, in semitones (sharps positive).

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `c`, `d`, `e`, `f`, `g`, `a`, `b` | `rational` | −3 to 3; a fraction is a microtone (`"1/2"` is a quarter-tone sharp) |

**`ModePattern`**: a mode, as the intervals of its scale from its tonic.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | |
| `tones` | `ToneCollection` | its first tone is `(0, 0)` (octave `null`) |
| `quality` | chord quality? | |

Major and Ionian have the same tones and are different modes:
a mode is compared by every field, its name included.

**`Key`**: a key. Kind *ModalContext*.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `tonic` | `TonalVector?` | `null` when no tonality is asserted: no key at all, or a bare signature ("three flats") that does not say which key |
| `signature` | `KeySignature?` | `null` for no signature (with a `null` tonic: no key) |
| `tones` | `ToneCollection` | the tones of the key's scale (D major: D E F♯ G A B C♯); empty when none are asserted |
| `mode` | `ModePattern?` | |
| `name` | `string` | |

A key always has a name:
where none is given, an implementation names it from its tonic and mode
(`"D Major"`, or `"3 flats"` for a bare signature),
and the name it gave is what is written.

## Clefs, bar lines and brackets

**`StaffClef`**: a clef on a staff. Kind *Clef*.

| field | type | domain |
|---|---|---|
| `sign` | clef sign | |
| `line` | `integer?` | 1–5 (counted from the bottom) for `"g"`, `"f"` and `"c"`; `null` for the others |
| `octave_change` | `integer` | octaves the staff sounds from where it is written: −1 for the treble clef with an 8 below |

**`BarLineShape`**: how a bar line is drawn, from left to right. Kind *DivisionShape*.

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `components` | `array<`bar line component`>` |

A final bar is `["thin", "thick"]`; an end repeat `["dots", "thin", "thick"]`.

**`BracketShape`**: how a group of staves is bracketed. Kind *StackGroupShape*.

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `symbol` | bracket symbol? |
| `bar_lines` | group bar lines |

## Percussion

**`PercussionTone`**: a stroke on an unpitched instrument, at a relative pitch.
Kind *Tone*. System `wsmn:percussion`.

| field | type |
|---|---|
| `relative_pitch` | relative pitch? |
| `stroke` | stroke? |

## Enumerations

| enumeration | values |
|---|---|
| chord quality | `"maj"`, `"min"`, `"sus"`, `"pow"`, `"aug"`, `"dim"`, `"dom"`, `"hdm"` |
| clef sign | `"g"`, `"f"`, `"c"`, `"percussion"`, `"tab"`, `"none"` |
| bar line component | `"thin"`, `"thick"`, `"dashed"`, `"dotted"`, `"short"`, `"tick"`, `"dots"` |
| bracket symbol | `"bracket"`, `"brace"`, `"line"`, `"square"` |
| group bar lines | `"separate"`, `"joined"`, `"mensurstrich"` |
| relative pitch | `"low"`, `"low_mid"`, `"mid"`, `"high_mid"`, `"high"` |
| stroke | `"center"`, `"edge"`, `"rim"`, `"rim_shot"`, `"cross_stick"`, `"shell"`, `"dead"`, `"open"`, `"slap"`, `"bass"`, `"mute"`, `"palm"`, `"finger"`, `"fist"`, `"heel"`, `"toe"`, `"closed"`, `"half_open"`, `"pedal"`, `"foot_splash"`, `"bell"`, `"crash"`, `"scrape"`, `"shake"`, `"thumb_roll"`, `"clap"`, `"snap"`, `"stomp"` |
